projects.problem: Figma-to-code is usually a vision model guessing at pixels: fidelity drifts between runs and every attempt costs tokens.
projects.did: Built a rule-based layout engine — an 8-stage pipeline (DSL → tree → layout → visual → export) with the VLM demoted to fallback, emitting a ZIP of index.html, slices and fonts that any LLM can convert to React, Vue, Swift or Kotlin.
projects.result: 98%+ SSIM fidelity, and the same design produces the same code twice.

projects.problem: Cleanup tools ask you to trust a one-click optimize button and never tell you what it deleted.
projects.did: Wrote a read-only audit: 152 cache paths measured against the live host, classified into three safety tiers, 9 gates before a single byte moves.
projects.result: 30.53 GB reclaimed with zero data loss; probe F1 = 1.00 on the measured set.

projects.problem: Every project needs a hand-written subagent team, and the roster silently drifts away from the real stack.
projects.did: A rules engine that scans up to 6,000 files — languages, frameworks, databases, test runner, build tooling, monorepo, Docker, CI — and deterministically emits 4–10 agents with per-agent tool allowlists and thinking levels.
projects.result: Zero model tokens spent on the scan; a React + Prisma + Vitest repo gets 8 agents in under 5 seconds.

projects.problem: AIGC long-video runs are unreproducible: one dead credential or one dropped poll burns the whole budget.
projects.did: Storyboard preflight, ordered credential failover, async polling, resumable downloads, ffmpeg post-production — plus a skill file that teaches the agent to drive the pipeline itself.
projects.result: A storyboard resumes from the last good segment instead of restarting from zero.

now.problem: figma-mcp-plus still falls back to the VLM on deeply overlapping layouts.
now.judgment: The DSL records overlap, overflow and containment but not z-order intent, so the layout stage cannot resolve stacking deterministically.
now.next: Insert an overlap-resolution stage between tree and layout, then measure SSIM on a fixed 20-screen overlap corpus before and after.
